run_make_lmdb_sizes: run the script to generate metadata.npz files for load balancing a DataLoader from an LMDB dataset
run_get_data: run the get_data function to extract natoms and neighbor counts from a dataset index
run_make_lmdb_sizes_function: run make_lmdb_sizes to compute and save atom counts and neighbor counts as a sorted metadata.npz file
run_get_lmdb_sizes_parser: run get_lmdb_sizes_parser to create an argparse parser with data-path and num-workers arguments
review_make_lmdb_sizes: review the make_lmdb_sizes function that uses multiprocessing to extract natoms and neighbors from an LMDB dataset
